name: openStaticEditor
description: Vue3 + Pinia + Electron 桌面应用
author: Let's UFO

scripts.package: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder
scripts.dist: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder
scripts.build:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 && node scripts/organize-release.js
scripts.build:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && node scripts/organize-release.js
scripts.dist:win: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-vite build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac
